items.name: 01-hero
items.prompt: Photorealistic interior photography, real estate photo, realistic proportions, no people, no text, no logos, no readable house numbers. The inside of a small enclosed brick and glass entrance porch on a British 1930s semi-detached house, seen from the inner front door looking out: a slim oak storage bench with shoes neatly underneath, a row of black peg hooks with two coats, black and white chequerboard floor tiles, a large coir doormat inside the glazed outer door, a potted olive tree, a woven basket, white painted brick walls and a warm pendant light. Daylight through the glazing, tidy and calm.
